---
title: "Exams and grading"
---

## Exam modality

Written exam with exercises and open questions. **Closed book:** students can use only paper, pen and a calculator. Any other electronic device or resource (books, notes, slides, etc.) is forbidden.

**The exam must be booked on Infostud.**

## Exam dates

::: {.callout-important}
## Extraordinary exam: Friday 23/10/2026

**Friday 23 October 2026, 14:00–17:00, classroom A3, DIAG.**

This is an **extraordinary exam date, reserved to students of the past edition of the course**. Students attending the current edition cannot take it. As for any other exam, booking on Infostud is required.
:::

The exam dates are listed in the [official exam calendar](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BkAWoEPz3hPWghPz1_bymiKeNsjoIpmc/edit?gid=1655048598#gid=1655048598){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}, which is the reference for dates, times and classrooms: check it before booking, since it is updated by the Department.
